answer: Admission requires a depth map from structured light plus a blink sequence, so a flat photo, a mask, or a screen replay fails the depth check while a real face passes in two seconds. A farm must put a thousand real faces in front of a thousand depth sensors, and a printed face is worthless, while one honest agent looks at the camera once. The river of the design is public, the canyon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays.
